title: Positivity of Small-Set Mass
statement: For a natural number $q$, set $\alpha=1/(q+2)$ and let $t$ be the standard Gaussian upper-tail quantile of mass $\alpha$. In the Boolean cube of dimension $d$ selected by the approximation property for $q$, let $A$ consist of the sign vectors whose normalized coordinate sum exceeds $t$, and let $\mu(A)$ be its uniform probability. Then $\mu(A)>0$.
